evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- Plans to make a trip to Boston after he finishes the Frank Ocean tour; has heard the music scene there is awesome and is excited to check it out [S3T9].
- Not yet seen Boston apart from gigs — he has been busy with rehearsals and traveling [S3T14][S3T15].
- Looking forward to exploring the city, trying out delicious food, and visiting popular attractions [S3T15].
- Dave (apparently Boston-based) is offering to show him around — including Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park — and to take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed grabbing a bite together when he is in Boston, and Dave agreed [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16] (see /memories/dave.md > ## Boston).
- Calvin is looking forward to trying the food in Boston with Dave and called it fun ("Can't wait to try out the food there with you") [S3T17].

Calvin: Wow, the crowd energy is amazing! It always gets me so pumped and it's awesome. Look at that photo, that was awesome!
[Image caption: a photography of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air]
[S24T9] (dia_id: D24:9)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, that's an awesome pic! Everyone looks so pumped. Where was that taken?
[S24T10] (dia_id: D24:10)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! That pic was taken in Tokyo during a concert. Man, the energy was nuts - felt like the whole city came out!
[S24T11] (dia_id: D24:11)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, Tokyo looks incredible! Here's a pic I found online, and it's making me dream about visiting someday. The energy there seems unbeatable! Have you ever visited streets like that?
[Image caption: a photo of a busy street with people walking and shopping]
[S24T12] (dia_id: D24:12)

Calvin: Yes, Dave! That was an incredible experience to visit similar streets like you shared in your photo. Is there anything else that interests you in Tokyo?
[S24T13] (dia_id: D24:13)

Dave: Of course, Calvin! Tokyo is amazing! I want to know everything about it - the people, the culture, the food, take a walk at the vibrant city life! In the photo below, the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive! It will be an unforgettable experience!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowded street at night with people walking and walking]
[S24T14] (dia_id: D24:14)

Calvin: That photo's a great pic! The lights, the people - so lively! Can't wait to hear your emotions when you see that in person!
[S24T15] (dia_id: D24:15)

Dave: It's really amazing. Hope I'll get to see it in person soon!
[S24T16] (dia_id: D24:16)

Calvin: Cool, Dave! I'm actually going to Tokyo next month after the tour ends. Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like the one in the photo below. What a great view!
[Image caption: a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background]
[S24T17] (dia_id: D24:17)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! That's great to hear! Any specific spots in Tokyo that you're really excited to check out?
[S24T18] (dia_id: D24:18)

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-04, was in Boston: he told Dave he had met with artists there the day before (2023-10-03) to plan a music collaboration (continuation of the planned Boston visit from his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 flight booking above; details in ## Music) [S21T1].
- On 2023-10-25, told Dave that the day before (2023-10-24) he had a great time sightseeing in Boston with a high school friend — "really fun and eye-opening"; he found Boston "a wonderful experience" with "awesome architecture and a really cool history," and said it was "so peaceful" — following Dave's advice (continuation of his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 Boston visit, see above; details in ## Relationships) [S26T1][S26T3].
- On 2023-10-29, while looking at Dave's Boston photos (the sunset-over-the-skyline photo and a close-up of the clock tower, see the 2023-10-29 entry in ## Music and the Photography section of /memories/dave.md), Calvin recognized the clock tower and said he was in Boston a few years back — "it's such a beautiful city." (a second, separate Boston visit, in addition to his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 visit above; "a few years back" — exact date not given) [S27T5][S27T7].
- On 2023-11-13, told Dave he invited his old high school friend (the same friend he sightseeing'd with on 2023-10-24, see above) to see him perform in Boston — "It was insane!" — (recent as of 2023-11-13; the show date itself is not specified) (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S29T1].
- On 2023-11-16, attended a "fancy gala" in Boston (told Dave about it on 2023-11-17, as "yesterday") and met some interesting people; shared a photo of himself and "the crew" (a photography of a group of men sitting on a rock next to a river) (Dave: "that event looks amazing! You all look awesome."; the Boston event — details in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships) [S30T2].

Calvin: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!
[S3T11] (dia_id: D3:11)

Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
[Image caption: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass]
[S3T12] (dia_id: D3:12)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!
[Image caption: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show]
[S3T13] (dia_id: D3:13)

Dave: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?
[S3T14] (dia_id: D3:14)

Calvin: Not yet, been pretty busy with rehearsals and traveling. But I'm looking forward to exploring the city, trying out some delicious food, and visiting the popular attractions. Maybe we can grab a bite together when I'm there?
[S3T15] (dia_id: D3:15)

Dave: Definitely, Cal! Let's grab some food and I'll show you my favorite spots in the city. Can't wait to show them to you!
[S3T16] (dia_id: D3:16)

Calvin: Sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to try out the food there with you. It'll be fun!
[S3T17] (dia_id: D3:17)

Dave: It'll be great, Cal! Can't wait to show you the amazing music and food here. See you soon!
[S3T18] (dia_id: D3:18)

- Later in the 2023-05-03 conversation: agreed with Calvin that driving with the wind in your hair, and walking around to explore the sights and sounds of nature, are calming [S5T9]; when Calvin said his music is stuck ("creativity's frozen"), gave him the creative-block tip (see ## Music) and encouraged Calvin to keep pursuing his music and never give up [S5T10][S5T11][S5T13]; the two said goodbye and agreed to keep in touch, with Dave saying Calvin can let him know if he ever needs help [S5T14][S5T15].
- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Calvin ("long time no chat"); when Calvin shared that his place had flooded, Dave expressed sympathy, said the saved music gear and mic were "the important things", told Calvin to stay positive, and offered to help [S6T3][S6T4]; Dave praised Calvin's home music studio photo — "That studio looks awesome" — and said he hopes Calvin gets it fixed soon so he can keep creating [S6T5][S6T6]; when Calvin asked what he's working on, Dave excitedly told him about the shop's opening celebration (details in ## Car maintenance shop), and Calvin said he can't wait to get back to making music [S6T7][S6T8].
- The 2023-05-16 exchange continued: Calvin congratulated Dave on the shop (see ## Car maintenance shop), and when Dave asked about Calvin's music, Calvin shared the upcoming Tokyo performance [S6T10][S6T11]; Dave said doing a show in Tokyo is "wow", was sure the audience would love it, and wished him luck — Calvin promised to keep him posted on how it goes [S6T12][S6T13]; when Calvin shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline (taken 2023-05-15), Dave called it a great shot, said the night skyline "really pops with those city lights," and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]; after Calvin said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing and encouraged him to visit, Dave said he is "definitely adding it to [his] list" and thanked Calvin [S6T17][S6T18].
- The 2023-06-09 conversation continued: Calvin asked what was new and exciting for Dave, and Dave announced he booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023) — "finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks" (details in ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T10]. Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to escape it all and de-stress — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S8T9]. The two exchanged trip wishes and signed off "see you soon" [S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin told Dave about a car accident he had on 2023-06-16 (no one hurt); Dave expressed sympathy, asked whether the insurance process had any issues and how long it took to sort out, and asked about the mechanic in Calvin's garage photo. Details of the accident and repair are in /memories/calvin.md > ## Car accident (2023-06-16) [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].

Dave: Hey Calvin! Haven't talked in a while! Last Friday I had a card-night with my friends, it was so much fun. We laughed and had a great time! Take a look at the photo!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards]
[S15T1] (dia_id: D15:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! Great to hear from you, card night sounds like a blast! Always love having fun with friends. Guess what? I scored a deal to continue collaboration with Frank Ocean! This is a dream come true for me, I've been working hard and it's finally paying off. No words can describe how happy I am.
[S15T2] (dia_id: D15:2)

Dave: Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you. How did this chance come up?
[S15T3] (dia_id: D15:3)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I had the opportunity to meet Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and we clicked. We've been speaking and sharing ideas we arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at my mansion - it's been great!
[S15T4] (dia_id: D15:4)

Dave: Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!
[S15T5] (dia_id: D15:5)

Calvin: It was an incredible experience, Dave! The city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was so lively - it was like fuel for my soul. Look at this photo, that's amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people sitting on the grass at night]
[S15T6] (dia_id: D15:6)

Dave: Wow, that sounds incredible! What was it like playing at the festival? Must have been an amazing experience.
[S15T7] (dia_id: D15:7)

Calvin: It was a dream come true, Dave! The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!
[S15T8] (dia_id: D15:8)

Dave: Sounds like you had a blast! Did any other collaborations come out of that performance? Any upcoming concerts we should know about?
[S15T9] (dia_id: D15:9)

Calvin: Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!
[S15T10] (dia_id: D15:10)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- How it came about: he met Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and they clicked; they've been speaking and sharing ideas, arranged a meeting, and Calvin recorded a song in the studio at his mansion (the mansion he is turning into a recording studio, see ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) — "it's been great!" [S15T4]. (This may be the Tokyo music festival he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20) — but that is not confirmed.)
- On that festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the festival crowd was "so lively" — "it was like fuel for my soul"; he called the experience "a dream come true" — "The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!"; shared a photo of the crowd (people sitting on the grass at night) [S15T6][S15T8].
- How it started — Calvin's account on 2023-10-19: "It all started August last year" (i.e., August 2022) when he and Frank Ocean met at a festival and Frank said he wanted to collaborate — "We clicked right away and the chemistry on stage was incredible. I'm so lucky!" This is a later, more specific account than the 2023-08-22 one (a Tokyo music festival, possibly the one he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)); the two accounts differ on when/where they met (August 2022 festival vs. a 2023 Tokyo festival) — both kept. [S24T5]
- On 2023-10-19, shared photos while telling Dave about the tour: of how he performed on stage (a photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights — "that was awesome!"), of him and Frank Ocean together on stage (a photo of a band performing on stage with a projection of a man on the wall — "we perfectly look together on stage"), and of the audience (a photo of a large crowd of people in a large auditorium — "Look at this crowd, that was insane!") [S24T1][S24T5][S24T7].

Dave: Wow, that looks amazing! How was it performing on that big stage?
[S16T3] (dia_id: D16:3)

Calvin: Performing on such a big stage was a dream come true! The energy was incredible and I felt on top of the world. It was seriously surreal.
[S16T4] (dia_id: D16:4)

Dave: Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!
[S16T5] (dia_id: D16:5)

Calvin: Cool! Last weekend I started shooting a video for my new album - can't wait for you to check it out! Look how great it was!
[Image caption: a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach]
[S16T6] (dia_id: D16:6)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Can't wait to see it. Will it be shot on location?
[S16T7] (dia_id: D16:7)

Calvin: We're doing the shoot in Miami and picked an awesome beach. It's going to have some epic visuals!
[S16T8] (dia_id: D16:8)

Dave: Sounds great, Calvin! The beaches in Miami are awesome - can't wait to see them!
[S16T9] (dia_id: D16:9)

Calvin: Oh man, they are amazing! I love the Miami vibe, it's perfect for the vid. Can't wait to show you!
[S16T10] (dia_id: D16:10)

Dave: Looking forward to it! I'm excited to see the vibe and the location. Let me know if you need any help with props or anything else for the video. I'm here to support you!
[S16T11] (dia_id: D16:11)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'll let you know if I need any assistance with props or anything else. Your support is much appreciated.
[S16T12] (dia_id: D16:12)

- The 2023-08-22 conversation continued: Dave asked whether any other collaborations came out of the performance and about upcoming concerts; Calvin: "Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!" (collaborator and tour details in ## Music and ## Boston trip); Dave agreed to meet up when Calvin is in Boston and asked for the details when he has them; Calvin then almost-reminded himself and told Dave that on 2023-08-21 he and his friends recorded a podcast about the rap industry (details in ## Podcast (2023-08-21)); Dave said he was looking forward to listening and to learning more about the rap industry, "Keep up the great work!"; Calvin said he'd let Dave know when the podcast will be uploaded, "Take care!"; Dave: "Sure, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing about it. See ya then!" [S15T9][S15T10][S15T11][S15T12][S15T13][S15T14][S15T15].
- On 2023-08-31, reconnected with Dave ("Long time no chat!"): Dave asked how the end of the tour was ("I bet it was amazing!"), and Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — sharing a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, and Calvin said it was "a dream come true", he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal"; Dave: "Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!"; Calvin then said he'd started shooting a video for his new album the weekend before (~2023-08-25/26) — "can't wait for you to check it out!" — and shared a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach ("Look how great it was!"); Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked whether it will be shot on location; Calvin: the shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!" (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20) and ## Music video (Miami, 2023-08-31)) [S16T1][S16T2][S16T3][S16T4][S16T5][S16T6][S16T7][S16T8].
- On 2023-09-02, reconnected with Dave ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): Dave said he's been tied up with car stuff and had just come back from San Francisco with great insights on car modification (details in the Car workshops in San Francisco section of /memories/dave.md), and that fixing things gives him a sense of purpose and pride (details in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin understood the satisfaction of giving things a new life ("It's like you're giving them new life"), and said Dave must feel great making a real difference in someone's life — "like being their superhero!" — and that he should be proud of bringing joy to others [S17T1][S17T2][S17T3][S17T4][S17T5]. Calvin then told Dave he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is so excited about the upcoming trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it (details in ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)); Dave: "Let me know when you're free and we can catch up in Boston."; Calvin: he'll let him know when he's in Boston, and they signed off "See you soon!" [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The 2023-09-02 chat then closed: Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!", and Calvin thanked him, told Dave to stay safe on the trip, said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, caught up with Dave after a slow response ("Sorry it took me so long to get back to you. Crazy times since we talked!"): announced his album finally dropped on 2023-09-11 ("a wild feeling") and that everyone's been loving it, which has motivated him to keep going (details in ## Music); Dave congratulated him on the release ("that's awesome!") and asked whether it's been overwhelming or inspiring; Calvin said it's been a lot, that it's "kinda overwhelming to think so many appreciate it" but cool that it's connecting with people, and that it motivates him to make even better music; Dave: "That's awesome, Calvin! It's such a great feeling when your work gets noticed and makes a positive difference. It must be really motivating for you to keep chasing your dreams."; Calvin: such moments remind him why he got into music — making a difference and sharing his own story — the positive feedback gives him strength to reach more people, "My journey's just getting started!"; Dave: "Wow, Calvin! You've come a long way since we started talking music. What's next for you? Anything exciting coming up?"; Calvin: "Lots of cool stuff happening. Next up, a tour - so excited! After that, I'm off to explore and grow my brand. Can't wait to see what the future has in store!" (tour and brand details in ## Music); Dave: "Wow, Calvin! Congrats on the upcoming tour! Can't wait to see you perform. Do you have any cities or venues in mind?" — Calvin did not answer that question in this exchange [S18T1][S18T2][S18T3][S18T4][S18T5][S18T6][S18T7][S18T8].
- The 2023-09-13 conversation continued: Calvin got excited about the tour stops — "Yay! Dave! We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!" — and Dave said live music is the best, was sure Calvin would have a blast on tour and make awesome memories, and offered to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars — renewing his long-standing offer to show Calvin some cars when he comes to Boston (details in the Boston section of /memories/dave.md). Dave shared a photo of the garage (a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign) — "Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!"; Calvin accepted the offer — "I'll definitely take you up on that offer" — hoping it would be fun and maybe give him ideas for future projects, and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston (details in ## Boston trip); the chat closed with mutual goodbyes — Dave: "Thanks again for your help. Bye! Have a great day." and "Catch you later", and Calvin: "No problem! Always good chatting with you. Have an awesome day!" (Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S18T9][S18T10][S18T11][S18T12][S18T13][S18T14][S18T15][S18T16].

- Apparently based in Boston: on 2023-04-20 he offered to show Calvin around town when he visits [S3T10].
- For Calvin's upcoming visit, mentioned the awesome music scene and named Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park; said he'll count himself in for the front row when Calvin is up onstage [S3T10].
- Shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water (Calvin's reply indicates it's Boston); Calvin said Boston looks great and thanked him for the tips [S3T10][S3T11].
- Plans to take Calvin to his favorite spots in the city for food; Calvin proposed grabbing a bite together, and Dave agreed enthusiastically [S3T15][S3T16].

- On 2023-04-20, reconnected with Dave ("long time no see") and updated him on the Tokyo music festival; Dave reacted positively and asked where he sees his music going [S3T1][S3T2][S3T8].
- On 2023-04-20, Dave offered to show him around Boston and take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed meeting up for a meal when he is in Boston (details in the Boston trip section above) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16].
- The 2023-04-20 conversation closed with both of them looking forward to the visit — Calvin said he can't wait to try the food with Dave, and Dave replied he can't wait to show Calvin the amazing music and food in Boston, signing off "See you soon!" [S3T17][S3T18].
- On 2023-05-01, congratulated Dave on opening his own car maintenance shop — "Congrats on achieving your dream", said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised Dave's "guts and ambition" and told him to "keep it up", was enthusiastic about Dave going after classic cars ("Fulfilling your dreams is so important"), and called the photo of the restored car's engine "awesome" (details on Dave's shop in /memories/dave.md > ## Car maintenance shop) [S4T2][S4T4][S4T6][S4T8].
- On 2023-05-01, said he'd love to check Dave's shop out sometime and asked what sort of cars he works on (Dave: all kinds, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars) [S4T17][S4T18][S4T19].
